notes.title: Developer Note
notes.content:
[p]It’s been a while since our last update.[/p][p align="justify"]It’s hard to believe that <SANABI> was released almost two years ago. Even now, we continue to feel the passion and love that players have for the game. Developing <SANABI> has never been easy, but because of your support, we’ve been able to move forward step by step. Thank you, truly.
[/p][p align="justify"]Today, we’re excited to share news about <SANABI>’s first DLC.
[/p][p align="justify"]When we originally set our TumblBug goal, we promised two short DLC episodes (20–30 minutes each). But the response to <SANABI> has been far greater than we expected. In return, we wanted to create something more meaningful for you.
[/p][p align="justify"]That said, <SANABI> is a tightly structured, linear game. Its story already has a closed ending, and the gameplay leaves little room to expand. We tested countless ideas for new levels and modes, but most felt incomplete or unworthy of the game—so we set them aside. We also decided that making a flimsy spin-off just for the sake of content would not be respectful to the fans who cherish the original experience.
[/p][p align="justify"]Instead, we’re preparing something different: a spin-off DLC featuring a brand-new playable character, completely distinct from the main hero.
[/p][p align="justify"]With that, we’re happy to reveal:[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]<SANABI: A HAUNTED DAY>[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"](*This content is still under development, so some details may change.)
[/p][p align="justify"]This spin-off DLC will be released for free. We hope you’ll enjoy it as much as we’ve enjoyed pouring our time and effort into creating it.[/p][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey with us.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/7ca30c8ffe63b0795e6ebe9fd522f15f05320e64.png"][/img] 
[b]1.New protagonist: Major Song[/b][b]
 [/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/4a52c17e3d7ade59896ec3e939fd4442757f5ae7.gif"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]As many of you guessed, the protagonist this time is Major Song. The story is about the Major. Song when she worked for Uigeumbu No. 12, also before she encountered the General.[/p][p align="justify"]While the main character of <SANABI> showcased stylish aerial maneuvers with the grappling hook, Major Song brings her own dynamic combat style - combining recoverable mid-aerial jumps with the raw power of her shotgun.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/d28d67cc493eabef5933e2c49b07b6a30e0b0f96.gif"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]With these two abilities, Major Song can unleash spectacular aerial maneuvers. Don’t worry about the new controls—if you’ve played <SANABI>, you’ll find them easy to pick up and master.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/48ad09c4ceeed9e526b2a6d8e910528ea6d93982.gif"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Block enemy attacks and unleash Burst Mode to overpower them for a limited time. Wield a massively powerful enhanced shotgun to deal devastating damage. Step into the role of Major Song—the youngest ever to pass the martial exam, and a government-certified living weapon![/p][p][/p][p][b]1.Spin-Off : A HAUNTED DAY[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Operation 3 takes place in the assault bot scrapyard on the outskirts of Hanyang.[/p][p align="justify"]Following a lead on a treason plot, Major Song plunges into the massive scrapyard—only to sense that something about this place… isn’t right.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/f374b0a779573c2ca8994ef30de5ca9f2aee2cb3.gif"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Of course, there are the oddly aggressive robots and hostile signaling devices. Add to that the unjust orders from a superior, the strange happenings within the assault bot scrapyard, and… a General wielding the Steel Tiger?[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]It almost feels like today is haunted.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/f614a9d13d7233f0f49f77e301e78883147aa501.gif"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]What’s happening in this scrapyard? About a 2-hour scenario, 8 normal stages, and 2 bosses are waiting for you! (and speed run! 🏍️)[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: SANABI Official Release Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings from Wonder Potion. 

It’s already been a year and a half since we excitedly released the Early Access last June 22nd. 

We were able to create an improved game thanks to the beta tests and the invaluable feedback from the community. 

We want to take a moment to express our heartfelt gratitude – thank you. 

With the support from all of you, we are now ready for the official release. 
In this official release version, players can enjoy all chapters and endings. 
For those who played the Early Access version – your progress will be transferred, allowing you to continue your adventure from the subsequent chapters. 


[h2][b]Patch Notes: [/b][/h2]

[b]1. New Chapter Addition & Existing Chapter Enhancements[/b]
- Added content up to the ending after Chapter 3
- Added scenes for the Chapter 2 boss (Justice)
- Significant improvements to the story and stages in Chapter 3
- Other sub-events and existing events have been improved


[b]2. Addition of Multiple Endings[/b]
- 2 additional endings that players can unlock depending on their choices


[b]3. Improvement in Controls[/b]
- Improved responsiveness of controls, including adjustments in Chain Arm delay and range
- Enhanced aiming correction mechanism for Chain Arm


[b]4. Improvement in Level Design[/b]
- Fixed stages that were excessively long or difficult
- Improved terrain structures that were inconvenient for players using controllers


[b]5. Sound Enhancements[/b]
- Added a lot of missing SFX and BGM 


[b]6. Addition of achievements and Steam collectibles[/b]


[b]7. Bug Fixes[/b]
- Bugs and issues reported up to this point have been fixed

※ The speedrun mode will be polished and updated shortly after the official release. 
We are also excited to announce the release of two free DLCs, exploring the past of the protagonist and Mari. These DLCs are planned to be released in the first half of 2024, so please look forward to it!

If you come across any issues or have suggestions, please don’t hesitate to inform us via Steam Community or our official Discord channel. We assure you that your concerns will be promptly addressed.  

One again, we express our deepest appreciation for your unwavering love and support. 

Best regards,
Wonder Potion.

notes.content:
Hello!
This is Wonder Potion.

Hope everyone’s having a great time with SANABI.
We’re back with a short, but sweet devlog.

Based on the roadmap we shared last time, today’s devlog will have a deeper dive into each contents that are planned.
(*Following contents are currently wip and can be a subject to change)

[h2][b]Current Development[/b][/h2]

[b]1. Chapter 4 : The top level of Mago[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/b197cd50c6586958311bd388cb8000a1772d13fd.png[/img]

The one-of-a-kind skyscraper, this is Mago’s top level.
Literally a palace for the board members, investors, and those who proved they are “elegant” enough to join the most prestigious group.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/353a3864a18446c1771212bb17a6e65d21ab5465.gif[/img]

All the paperworks, the process itself that takes over a year that needs just to visit the top level, and the distance itself have been the biggest complaints among the middle class.
But this never has been a problem for the Mago company. After all, the top level is only for the ‘selected’ people.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/3c7c93378c9d2073b0f07d3c67d4848343d5dd23.gif[/img]

And there…at the fanciest place that waits for the player, were the most unexpected things.



[b]2. New Ability : Dash[/b]

Character’s new ability that’s available at Ch.4

[img]https://tumblbug-images.imgix.net/posts/8fe5431f-3d61-47dc-8f97-df8891701db0.gif[/img]

Even when the player’s not holding onto something by the chain arm, they can still go to any direction freely by dashing. This would help to sort out the maze-like map, but it might not be the most needed skill for the players who already came all the way to Chapter 4.
But then again, the true power of dash can be felt when used during the battle

[img]https://tumblbug-images.imgix.net/posts/d1303e07-1178-4f84-a710-99974b34b680.gif[/img]

By dashing, players can defeat the heavily armed monsters or push them with the mighty force to the opposite direction.
They won’t have a chance to stop you when you’re dashing!



[b]3. Improving the aiming system[/b]

<SANABI> asks the player for precise aiming within a few seconds and because of this, the game recommends the keyboard & mouse for the best experience.
Even with this in mind, we noticed through the valuable feedback from our early access players, that the game’s environment for playing with the controller wasn’t good enough.
Now that we confirmed our release on Switch, there needs to be a fundamental improvement on this system and not only just having a larger hitbox.

[img]https://tumblbug-images.imgix.net/posts/2be12667-6bb4-4734-8bff-c11d51d5cc2d.gif[/img]

This is our improved aiming system.

1. It automatically finds ‘the objects that can be grabbed’ within a specific angle
2. Among the objects, it shoots the grappling hook to the most prioritized one
3. If there are more than one prioritized object, it will go for the closest one that is at the aiming direction

Based on this improvement, we plan to find the best aiming system that reflects the intention of the player's control.

The Switch version is also currently under development.

notes.title: Dev Note #2 & Key Changes in Development
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is Wonder Potion.

[b]The core game mechanics[/b] of SANABI are finished for the most part, so our team is now focusing on adding [b]new content[/b]. We're working hard to polish the game so that each chapter is unique in its own way, and we hope our players will notice that as well.

[b]Here's what's coming to SANABI![/b]
(*These are all work in progress, so they are still subject to change throughout development)

[h3]Boss Battle: The Writ of Execution[/h3]

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/f5586cc77273df52022c6fd52eb264a481a93b8f.gif[/img]
[*] An estranged, colossal disintegrator, the [b]“Writ of Execution”[/b]
[*] It’s certainly not an easy task to take down a giant disintegrator. But for some reason, [b]the Writ of Execution’s core[/b] is fully exposed...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/757f437584b84fd3c7100d5b4d795a5d6c05584e.gif[/img]
[*] Fortunately for you, there are some cargo drones left around the loading deck! We know Mari is very good at [b]tampering with drones[/b]. Perhaps she can help you dismantle the disintegrator?
[/list]


[h3]Game Controls[/h3]

[b]A. Winding[/b]
[list]
[*] Many of you asked [b]if you can reel in the Chain Arm[/b]. 
[*] The ability to wind the Chain Arm was, in fact, already coded in from the start. Introducing this feature too early led to most of the players relying on winding instead of practicing their swinging skills, and we wanted to avoid that. As such, we decided to make winding available [b]in the later stages[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/3ba9fd5ce7de4461129048fa02939f41fd57537f.gif[/img]
[*] Now, you can wind your Chain Arm whenever you want once you unlock the ability. We hope you enjoy the freedom this provides!
[/list]


[b]B. Chain Arm’s Increased Range[/b]
[list]
[*] SANABI requires you to make the most out of its huge maps. We’re sure there were many instances where you felt the Chain Arm was just [b]too short[/b]. But if we were to increase the chain’s length, an unnecessarily long range would also be difficult to work with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/0cb80cff5c0c5653c1e89dc3f8e2f2af9725f3c9.gif[/img]
[*] We’ve changed the mechanics so that the chain shoots long enough, and [b]at the same time, its length will automatically adjust to a reasonable distance.[/b] Swing to your heart’s content!
[/list]


[h3]Chapter 2 : Business District, Mago City[/h3]

[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/c0c7c2867f0918f58a17bf159400c62c98f904c0.gif[/img]
[*] Welcome to [b]the Business District of Mago City[/b], the center of capitalism thriving under the protection of imposing authority. A tall skyscraper looming over the city has given the area the alias, Sunless City. No matter! We might not get enough sun, but [b]there are plenty of hologram signs to light the city streets.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/b30284559be1b20a1ad055e1c69c053847222fa4.gif[/img]
[quote=author] Chapter 1 took place in [b]the slums of Mago City[/b]. In chapter 2, you’ll be running through [b]Mago City’s Business District[/b]. Compared to the rainy and gloomy environment of the slums, the Business District is [b]a vibrant ocean of neon signs[/b]. We’ve designed the area to reflect the theme of corrupted capitalism, which is visually represented by sky-high buildings. [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/14540d3a1c157d52498a2f4438b2fc830f3c5605.gif[/img]
[*] The Business District is maintained and operated by [b]the local police force[/b]. They use their so-called legal authority granted by the city to enforce peace, and [b]will resort to any form of violence to do so[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/d5c9c4e02f5288c0997526a56e99bd1b0ed2cb9d.gif[/img]
[*] Sky Tracks are seen all around the district. They’re meant to be reliable, hi-tech freight transports... but a certain (burly) someone might be able to use them as his own method of transportation.
[/list]


[h3]Title Change[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40033103/17651714da68d6efd408ba3f29ee3e0ef069016c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The English title of the game has officially changed from <SANNABI: the revenant> to [b]<SANABI>[/b]!
[*] We’ve received feedback from our publisher’s localization expert regarding the spelling and decided to remove the extra N to make SANABI look more appealing to our players in the west.
[*] The word Sanabi holds a significant meaning in the story, but it’s also one of the first things that determine the impression our game has on you, the players. We’d like to keep the title as simple as possible while maintaining its identity.
[*] The subtitle "The Revenant" was also removed to maintain unity with the original title in Korean, which will remain as 산나비.
[/list]


[h2]Change in Schedule[/h2]

[list]
[*] Though our team members put in days and weeks of effort to bring SANABI to you, we’ve realized that [b]we will need to invest more time to create something acceptable[/b] in terms of quality.

[*] [b]We apologize to many players who have been waiting for the official release of SANABI.[/b] We know how much love and support we’ve already received from you, and we would like to return the favor [b]with a solid, well-polished game[/b].

[/list]

[h3]2nd Closed Beta date[/h3]
[list]
[*] November, 2021 → [b]January, 2022[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Game release date[/h3]
[list]
[*] February, 2022 → [b]Q3, 2022[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Steam Early Access[/h3]

[list]
[*] With the way the above dates were pushed back, we now have a large gap between the 2nd Closed Beta and official release.
[*] Instead of making our players wait an indefinite amount of time, we've decided to release the game as Early Access in [b]Q2 of 2022[/b]. The Early Access version of the game will include chapter 3, which accounts for roughly [b]50~60%[/b] of the game's content.
[*] We'll be sharing details on the second round of Closed Beta and Early Access release with you via our community platforms.
[/list]

Again, we sincerely apologize for the delay and thank you for your understanding. [u]We appreciate every comment from you guys and it has always been the biggest motivation for us developers.[/u]

The weather’s gotten much colder. What a season for staying home and gaming! We’ll bring out another update soon, so please keep an eye on us!

Thank you!
Wonder Potion

notes.content:
Hello gamers, WONDER POTION here!

Long time no see! (We missed you guys soooo much!) 

After receiving tons of feedback through the previous demo, we continued to develop new content for ‘SANNABI’. It’s been a while, and finally, we’re fully geared up for [b]our very first Closed Beta[/b]!

[h2]Changes in First Closed Beta[/h2]
[h3]System[/h3]
[b]Combat System[/b]	
[list]
[*] Now if you hit the enemy, you can grip and drag him/her on the ground for a while. When the cooldown ends or the grappling releases, the enemy will be executed and you will dash toward where the mouse is located. With the player manipulating the starting point of the dash, every battle will be easier and more strategic.
[/list]
[b]Reversal Dash[/b]
[list]
[*] We’ve added a ‘Reversal Dash’ to avoid ‘Electric tiles’ from killing the player with a single blow. ‘Reversal Dash’ lets the player swiftly change its direction and dash when hit by enemies. If you make full use of the skill, you'll be able to easily escape and gain extra opportunities. Don’t be afraid of the red tiles anymore, let yourself fly solo across the city! 
[/list]
